title: Understanding the Model
text: The model is given by $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1+f{\left(x_i\right)} \beta_2$$. We need to determine if $$f(x)=x$$ can fit the data points in the scatterplot.

title: Analyzing the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot. Does the relationship between $$x$$ and $$y$$ appear linear? If so, $$f(x)=x$$ might be a suitable choice.

title: Checking Linearity
text: Does the scatterplot show a linear relationship between $$x$$ and $$y$$?

title: Conclusion
text: If the relationship is linear, then $$f(x)=x$$ can be used to fit the data using the given model.
